card.fires_on: Fires on the middle of words like peroxide, Precautions, Reactions and contraindicated, and on 'the' or 'of' in 'increases the risk of'. It appears in warning and contraindication text of drug labels.

modes.description: Inside long words broken into pieces, such as peroxide, Precautions, Adverse Reactions, contraindicated.
